nodes_add.name: Bholanath (Ramani Mohan Chakravarti)
nodes_add.note: Anandamayi Ma's husband and first disciple; initiated by her at Bajitpur (Dec 1922 or 3 Jan 1923); died Kishenpur, Dehradun, 6 May 1938

nodes_add.name: Bhaiji (Jyotish Chandra Roy)
nodes_add.note: Dhaka devotee who named her Anandamayi (1925 per ashram chronology); died Almora, August 1937

nodes_add.name: Arnaud Desjardins
nodes_add.note: French writer and filmmaker; disciple of Anandamayi Ma

nodes_add.name: Mhalsapati
nodes_add.note: Khandoba temple priest at Shirdi who greeted the young fakir as 'Ya Sai'; lived closely with him

nodes_add.name: Abdul Baba
nodes_add.note: Muslim attendant of Shirdi Sai Baba from 1889; kept a notebook in Deccani Urdu (translated by Marianne Warren); caretaker of the tomb

nodes_add.name: Venkusa of Selu
nodes_add.note: Hindu guru named as Sai Baba's teacher in Das Ganu's Bhaktisaramrita (1925) and Narasimhaswami; claim only

nodes_add.name: B.V. Narasimhaswami
nodes_add.note: Promoter of Shirdi Sai Baba's worship from 1936; founded the All India Sai Samaj (1940); never met him

nodes_update.name: Anandamayi Ma
nodes_update.note: Self-initiated (1922); no human guru; Shree Shree Anandamayee Sangha

nodes_update.name: Shirdi Sai Baba
nodes_update.note: Birth date and place unknown; Pathri claim disputed

edges_upsert.note: Took part in Kali worship in Dhaka; devotees called her a form of Kali
Explained herself mainly in Advaita terms (Matri Vani)
Bengali Vaishnava devotion of her family; kirtan in childhood
December 1922 per ashram chronology; 3 January 1923 per Hallstrom
Her second disciple; met in Dhaka (1922 or 1924 depending on source)
Fakir's dress, mosque, Allah Malik, Fatiha and qawwali; Warren's reading from Abdul's notebook
Marathi bhakti framing in the Satcharita (ovi verse)
Reported by Das Ganu (1925) and Narasimhaswami; no contemporary evidence
About three years under his instruction, largely at the Khandoba temple
Single meeting, December 1915 (Meher Baba Trust chronology)
Posthumous; promoted his worship in south India
Claimed reincarnation, declared May 1940 at age 13; Prema Sai prophecy 1963

anandamayi-ma.mdx: the move to Dhaka is April 1922 in the ashram chronology and 1924 in Hallstrom; the text gives both. Bholanath's initiation likewise (Dec 1922 vs 3 Jan 1923).
anandamayi-ma.mdx: Qur'an recitation at a Muslim shrine in Dhaka is kept hedged ('her biographers report') but was not found in the sources fetched.

Both chapters run close to the lower bound of the 3,000-4,500 word range once references are excluded.

anandamayi-ma: Birth 30 Apr 1896 Kheora; Feb marriage at 12y10m; joined husband 1915 Ashtagram; self-initiation Aug 1922; Purna Brahma Narayan Dec 1922; Dhaka Apr 1922 -> https://www.anandamayi.org/life-history/
Marriage 7 Feb 1909; joined 1914; Bholanath initiation 3 Jan 1923; 3-year silence; fed by others from 1926 -> https://mahavidya.ca/2008/04/15/anandamayi-ma/

Named Anandamayi 1925; 1925 Kali puja goat sacrifice; Raipur June 1932; Kamala Nehru July 1933; Bose 20 Oct 1938; Bhaiji d. 17 Aug 1937 Almora; Bholanath d. 6 May 1938 Kishenpur; Gandhi Wardha Feb 1942; Kanya Ashram 1938 -> https://www.anandamayi.org/ashram/cc.htm
Indira Gandhi 13 Apr 1966 visit; hospital 26 Dec 1968; Trudeau 11 Jan 1971 Varanasi -> https://www.anandamayi.org/life-history-1963-1972
Rudraksha at 1966 swearing-in; Kanyapeeth early 1940s -> https://granta.com/?p=175
Yogananda quote 'Father, there is little to tell...' -> https://hinduwebsite.com/sacredscripts/spiritualism/yogananda/yogananda_45.asp
Elite/high-caste criticism; purity rules in ashrams; charity remark -> https://www.encyclopedia.com/religion/dictionaries-thesauruses-pictures-and-press-releases/anandamayi-ma
shirdi-sai-baba: 'Nobody knew the parents, birth or birth-place'; lad of sixteen under neem; Chand Patil, Dhoop, two months, 'Ya Sai'; Hemadpant first visit 1910 -> https://cincysaitemple.org/storage/2024/08/sai-charitra-english-complete-book.pdf

Ch. VII: pierced ears / believed in circumcision; Ramnavami and Sandal procession; dhuni; 'always recite Allah Malik' -> https://sai.org.in/sites/default/files/sai-samarth-charita-english-chapter7.pdf

Dabholkar 1859 (or 1856)-1929; magistrate; at Shirdi intermittently 1910-1916; writing after 1918; 53 chapters, 9,000+ ovis -> https://www.sai.org.in/sites/default/files/sai-samarth-charita-english-preface.pdf

Satcharita cited as 1929 edition; Abdul arrived 1889, Deccani Urdu notebook; Warren 1999; 'never bark' paraphrase; 1985 fieldwork -> https://iris.unive.it/bitstream/10278/5105678/1/13.%20KERVAN_SOUTH%20ASIA_RIGOPOULOS.pdf
Pathri via Narasimhaswami/Mhalsapati; Venkusa in Das Ganu's Bhaktisaramrita 1925; Sansthan 1922; Narasimhaswami 1874-1956 -> https://wrldrels.org/?p=18481
Rani of Jhansi remark in Charters and Sayings; 25,000 pilgrims/day; Mohiddin Tamboli; age 16, c.1858 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sai_Baba_of_Shirdi

Rs 100 crore, Shirdi bandh, 'janmasthan' dropped; 8th edition of Shri Sai Charitra (1972-76); Durrani's response -> https://www.deccanherald.com/amp/story/opinion%2Fcontroversy-over-sai-baba-s-janmabhoomi-prakatbhoomi-karmabhoomi-797669.html
Varanasi Oct 2024 removals; Ajay Sharma detained -> https://www.business-standard.com/india-news/hindu-group-removes-sai-baba-statues-from-dozen-up-temples-chief-detained-124100300458_1.html
Meher Baba met Sai Baba and Upasni Dec 1915 -> https://avatarmeherbabatrust.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/CHRONOLOGY_1.pdf
Oral Testimonies, Oct-Nov 1985 interviews, 2020, CC BY -> https://edizionicafoscari.unive.it/en/edizioni4/libri/978-88-6969-447-9/preface
